narrative.headline: Discover Japan hikes with compact source facts and dated contributor evidence.
narrative.value_prop: Search named mountains, planned model courses, recorded trips and map areas. Keep source metrics and contributor observations separate from closure and safety decisions.
narrative.auth_narrative: Anonymous public first-party JSON reads; no account or paid key. Membership-only GPX and multi-landmark operations excluded.
narrative.when_to_use: Use for Japan hiking discovery on YAMAP and source report evidence. Resolve source IDs before fetching details.
anti_triggers: Official closure clearance or safety advice
Paid GPX downloads, accounts, route creation or bookings
